subproblem.title: Radial retraction of a face from its centre: gauge bounds, boundary values, radial estimate (parent steps 1 and 3)
subproblem.statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and a ∈ ℝ^P with |a_i − 1/2| < 1/4 for all i. Let b ∈ ℤ^P and J a nonempty set of coordinate indices, F := F(b, J) = {y : b_k ≤ y_k ≤ b_k + 1 (k ∈ J), y_k = b_k (k ∉ J)}. For y ∈ ℝ^P let N(y) := max_{k ∈ J} max((y_k − b_k − a_k)/(1 − a_k), (b_k + a_k − y_k)/a_k). This is the gauge of F − a_F at y − a_F, where a_F has coordinates b_k + a_k on J and b_k off J. Let ψ_F : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be any map with ψ_F(y)_i = b_i + a_i + (y_i − b_i − a_i)/N(y) for i ∈ J and ψ_F(y)_i = y_i for i ∉ J. Let x ∈ F with x_i ≠ b_i + a_i for some i ∈ J. Then: (1) |x_k − b_k − a_k| ≤ N(x) for all k ∈ J; (2) 0 < N(x) ≤ 1; (3) ψ_F(x) ∈ F; (4) ψ_F(x)_i ∈ {b_i, b_i + 1} for some i ∈ J; (5) if x_i ∈ {b_i, b_i + 1} for some i ∈ J, then ψ_F(x) = x; (6) for every y ∈ F with y_i ≠ b_i + a_i for some i ∈ J, |ψ_F(y) − ψ_F(x)| ≤ (1 + 4√|J|)/N(x) · |y − x|. Division by 0 is read as 0 (as in Lean). N(y) = 0 exactly when y_k = b_k + a_k for all k ∈ J (on F, only at the centre a_F); no conclusion uses ψ_F at such points.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (a : Euclid P), (∀ i, |a i - 1 / 2| < 1 / 4) → ∀ (b : Fin P → ℤ) (J : Finset (Fin P)) (hJ : J.Nonempty) (ψF : Euclid P → Euclid P), (∀ y : Euclid P, ∀ i, ψF y i = if i ∈ J then (b i : ℝ) + a i + (y i - b i - a i) / J.sup' hJ (fun k => max ((y k - b k - a k) / (1 - a k)) ((b k + a k - y k) / a k)) else y i) → ∀ x : Euclid P, (∀ i, (i ∈ J → (b i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ b i + 1) ∧ (i ∉ J → x i = b i)) → (∃ i ∈ J, x i ≠ b i + a i) → (∀ k ∈ J, |x k - b k - a k| ≤ J.sup' hJ (fun k => max ((x k - b k - a k) / (1 - a k)) ((b k + a k - x k) / a k))) ∧ 0 < J.sup' hJ (fun k => max ((x k - b k - a k) / (1 - a k)) ((b k + a k - x k) / a k)) ∧ J.sup' hJ (fun k => max ((x k - b k - a k) / (1 - a k)) ((b k + a k - x k) / a k)) ≤ 1 ∧ (∀ i, (i ∈ J → (b i : ℝ) ≤ ψF x i ∧ ψF x i ≤ b i + 1) ∧ (i ∉ J → ψF x i = b i)) ∧ (∃ i ∈ J, ψF x i = b i ∨ ψF x i = b i + 1) ∧ ((∃ i ∈ J, x i = b i ∨ x i = b i + 1) → ψF x = x) ∧ ∀ y : Euclid P, (∀ i, (i ∈ J → (b i : ℝ) ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ b i + 1) ∧ (i ∉ J → y i = b i)) → (∃ i ∈ J, y i ≠ b i + a i) → dist (ψF y) (ψF x) ≤ (1 + 4 * Real.sqrt J.card) / J.sup' hJ (fun k => max ((x k - b k - a k) / (1 - a k)) ((b k + a k - x k) / a k)) * dist y x
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: steps 1 (centres of faces) and 3 (the gauge N_F, the radial retraction ψ_F, ψ_F = id on ∂F, and the radial estimate) of the supplied proof of the selected parent dimred_mbl_dt_skeleton_retraction [its parent's Lemma D = Simon Ch. 6, Lemma 5.4, with the documented 3/4 → 1/4 erratum]. The estimate is stopped before the parent's last conversion |v| ≤ √j·N_F(v), i.e. it is kept in the gauge form (1 + 4√j)|y − x|/N_F(x − a_F).
Notation. c := a_F is the point with c_k = b_k + a_k (k ∈ J) and c_k = b_k (k ∉ J). For y ∈ ℝ^P and k ∈ J put t_k(y) := y_k − b_k − a_k and g_y(k) := max(t_k(y)/(1 − a_k), −t_k(y)/a_k). Then N(y) = max_{k ∈ J} g_y(k) (Finset.sup' over the nonempty J); it is the parent's gauge N_F(y − c) = max_{i∈J} max(v_i/(1 − a_i), −v_i/a_i), v = y − c. For y ∈ F, 'y ≠ c' means y_i ≠ b_i + a_i for some i ∈ J.
0. From |a_k − 1/2| < 1/4: 1/4 < a_k < 3/4. Hence 0 < a_k ≤ 1, 0 < 1 − a_k ≤ 1, 1/a_k < 4 and 1/(1 − a_k) < 4.
1. For every y and every k ∈ J, |t_k(y)| ≤ g_y(k) ≤ N(y). If t := t_k(y) ≥ 0, then t/(1 − a_k) ≥ t = |t| because 0 < 1 − a_k ≤ 1. If t < 0, then −t/a_k ≥ −t = |t| because 0 < a_k ≤ 1. Finally g_y(k) ≤ N(y) since k ∈ J (Finset.le_sup'). With y = x this is (1).
2. If y ∈ F then N(y) ≤ 1: for k ∈ J, b_k ≤ y_k ≤ b_k + 1 gives −a_k ≤ t_k(y) ≤ 1 − a_k, so t_k(y)/(1 − a_k) ≤ 1 and −t_k(y)/a_k ≤ 1, hence g_y(k) ≤ 1 (Finset.sup'_le). If moreover y ≠ c, then t_i(y) ≠ 0 for some i ∈ J, and N(y) ≥ |t_i(y)| > 0 by 1. With y = x this is (2). [Parent step 1: F − a_F lies in the unit ball of the gauge, and a_F ∈ F̆.]
3. Proof of (3). For i ∉ J, ψ_F(x)_i = x_i = b_i. For i ∈ J, g_x(i) ≤ N(x) and N(x) > 0 give t_i(x) ≤ N(x)(1 − a_i) and −t_i(x) ≤ N(x)·a_i, i.e. −a_i ≤ t_i(x)/N(x) ≤ 1 − a_i. Hence b_i ≤ ψ_F(x)_i = b_i + a_i + t_i(x)/N(x) ≤ b_i + 1.
4. Proof of (4). The maximum is attained (Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup'): N(x) = g_x(i) for some i ∈ J, and g_x(i) equals one of its two arguments. If N(x) = t_i(x)/(1 − a_i), then t_i(x)/N(x) = 1 − a_i and ψ_F(x)_i = b_i + 1. If N(x) = −t_i(x)/a_i, then t_i(x)/N(x) = −a_i and ψ_F(x)_i = b_i. [Parent step 3: ψ_F(x) is the point of ∂F on the ray from a_F through x.]
5. Proof of (5). If x_i = b_i (i ∈ J), then t_i(x) = −a_i and −t_i(x)/a_i = 1. If x_i = b_i + 1, then t_i(x)/(1 − a_i) = 1. In both cases N(x) ≥ g_x(i) ≥ 1, so N(x) = 1 by 2. Then ψ_F(x)_k = b_k + a_k + t_k(x) = x_k for k ∈ J and ψ_F(x)_k = x_k for k ∉ J, so ψ_F(x) = x (PiLp.ext). [Parent step 3: ψ_F = id on ∂F.]
6. The gauge is 4-Lipschitz. For all y, z and k ∈ J, t_k(y) − t_k(z) = y_k − z_k. Using |max(p, q) − max(p', q')| ≤ max(|p − p'|, |q − q'|) we get |g_y(k) − g_z(k)| ≤ max(|y_k − z_k|/(1 − a_k), |y_k − z_k|/a_k) ≤ 4|y_k − z_k| ≤ 4|y − z| (PiLp.dist_apply_le). Taking maxima over k ∈ J gives N(y) ≤ N(z) + 4|y − z| and symmetrically, so |N(y) − N(z)| ≤ 4|y − z|. [Parent step 3: N_F is 4-Lipschitz since each functional has norm < 4.]
7. Let y ∈ F with y ≠ c, and write N_x := N(x), N_y := N(y); both lie in (0, 1] by 2. For u ∈ {x, y} ⊆ F, (u − c)_k = t_k(u) for k ∈ J and (u − c)_k = 0 for k ∉ J, so ψ_F(u) = c + (u − c)/N(u) (coordinatewise check). Put v := x − c and w := y − c. By 1 at y, |w|² = Σ_{k ∈ J} t_k(y)² ≤ |J|·N_y², i.e. |w| ≤ √|J|·N_y. [Parent step 3: N_F(w) ≥ max_i |w_i| ≥ |w|/√j.]
8. Radial estimate (the parent's step-3 computation). ψ_F(y) − ψ_F(x) = w/N_y − v/N_x = (w − v)/N_x + w·(N_x − N_y)/(N_x·N_y). Hence |ψ_F(y) − ψ_F(x)| ≤ |w − v|/N_x + (|w|/N_y)·|N_x − N_y|/N_x ≤ |y − x|/N_x + √|J|·4|y − x|/N_x = (1 + 4√|J|)/N_x·|y − x|, using w − v = y − x, 7 and 6. This is (6). ∎

proof_key_steps: Coordinates of a lie in (1/4, 3/4); each gauge term g_y(k) dominates |y_k − b_k − a_k| and is at most 1 on F, so 0 < N(x) ≤ 1 for x ≠ a_F.
ψ_F(x) stays in F; the coordinate attaining the maximum is pushed to b_i or b_i + 1; on ∂F, N = 1 and ψ_F = id.
Radial estimate: |w/N_y − v/N_x| ≤ |w − v|/N_x + (|w|/N_y)|N_x − N_y|/N_x ≤ (1 + 4√|J|)|y − x|/N(x).
